# $crav1-verify-build-against-spec

lane: build | group: Verify and fix | starter: no | stage: stable | since: 1.0.0 | prompts: 3
purpose: Map every v0 acceptance line to tests or UI checks and report pass, fail, or missing.
use_when: Want proof against acceptance
reads: Reads `spec.md`, `plan.md`, `tasks.md`, the previous `verify.md`, and the running tree. It does not open `build-map.md`, `claims.md`, `walk-progress.md` or a log unless a step names it.
writes: Writes `verify.md`. After a yes on a tick-pending line, ticks that one `[ ]` row in `tasks.md`.
leaves alone: Leaves `spec.md` and product code alone. Does not tick a row without a yes, and does not re-implement.
limits: does not run `$crav1-fix-bug` or `$crav1-review-pr`.
flow:
- the tick offer for a task recorded merged sits inside Run next, label above `verify_rows.py tick --file <spec-folder>/verify.md --task <T#> --merged yes`, never after the ending; the tick is written only after a yes.
- `verify_rows.py set` keeps CRLF files CRLF and re-sorts a count line only when its ids change.
- a rerun verifies again only the rows whose branch or tip moved since the last verify, or every row when spec.md, plan.md or tasks.md changed (`scripts/verify_rows.py scope`), and the reply says which rows were kept (`Kept from the last verify: T1, T3 (branch and tip unchanged).`).
- `verify_rows.py set --task T# --status <status> --evidence <evidence> --branch <b> --tip <sha> --yes` writes one row, recounts the TL;DR and records the tip under `## Row tips`.
- with no hand-written steps, the reply's branch blocks come from the ready check (`walk_ending.ready_branch_blocks`), with descriptions, open tasks and the whole-branch entry; a task that waits on a merge is not offered.
- a `T6 failed:` change line in the reply keeps the Verify cell's opening sentence and the sentence naming the cause, not the run detail; the ready check's Catch up first line uses the same short reason.
- `verify.md` has no `Next:` line any more; the chat reply's Run next names the next step.
- The ready check still reads an older file that has one, and a Verified or Failed row there is never behind.
- the chat reply is brief and built by `scripts/walk_ending.py --verify <state file> --vendor codex` (a wrapper for the shared ending script): `Verify — <slug>`, a `Result:` line with the counts, one line per task whose state changed since the last verify (`T6 failed: ...`, `T44 row dropped: not in tasks.md`), `Run next:`, Waiting for what you cannot act on now, then `Report: docs/specs/<slug>/verify.md`.
- Run next opens with a `**Catch up first**` block when something can be settled now: a plan note (`$crav1-tighten-plan <slug>`) and an uncommitted `verify.md` (`$crav1-finalize-commit`, then `git push`).
- Then the next step: the reason once, the label on its own line and the command alone in its code span; there is no `Next:` line.
- The TL;DR, tables and branch detail stay in `verify.md`; the word `full` shows the TL;DR and Tasks overview in chat.
- The run reads only spec, plan, tasks, the previous `verify.md` and the reference a step names, not `build-map.md`, `claims.md`, `walk-progress.md` or a log.
- The live checks and `verify.md` are unchanged.
- the Tasks overview has one row per T# in `tasks.md`; a row for a T# that `tasks.md` does not have is dropped and the reply names it.
- when `$crav1-build-walk` opened this skill, do not print the case Next.
- TL;DR of implemented vs not, then acceptance details in `verify.md`.
- A test skipped for a missing dependency blocks verified unless you chose skip; then `verify.md` lists it under Skipped tests.
- A missing dependency is a `BLOCKER:` line at the top of the summary, also in a headless run, which uses the two-pass questions file.
- the `Sub-branches:` and `left behind:` lines, done when the top-level branches reached the base, and `merged, reverted on <base> (<sha>)`, report only.
- the `Promotion:` line in the TL;DR and verify.md, with the optional `pipeline-runs` check; done stays merged.
- the spec folder is `scripts/resolve_spec.py` (exact folder, then hyphen and space forms, then one unique playbook basename, spec title, or work-item name).
- A task whose evidence passed, whose row is still `[ ]`, and whose pull request is recorded merged is **Implemented, verified, tick pending**.
- `scripts/resolve_spec.py` also accepts one unique ordered token subsequence of a folder name, playbook basename, spec title, or work-item name (`cc 1.0` matches `cc-process-1-0`).
- the spec folder command is `<interpreter> -X utf8 <skill crav1-tasks-ready-to-build>/scripts/resolve_spec.py "<query>" --root docs/specs`.
- On Windows `<interpreter>` is `python` with `PYTHONUTF8=1`.
- Elsewhere it is `python3`.
- The rule is `docs/reference/running-scripts.md`.
- `Implemented, verified, tick pending` is the one wording for evidence that passed with the row still `[ ]`, on an unmerged branch or recorded merged.
- `verify_rows.py set` writes only that wording, rewrites an old `Implemented, verified on branch` row once when it touches the file, and a single row no longer moves the whole-file `Spec stamp:`; `--all-rows` on the last row of a full verify does.

## Choice words
- question: Also check the latest pipeline runs?
  - `pipeline-runs`: check the latest successful Azure DevOps runs behind the Promotion line (read-only)
- question: Long reply?
  - `full`: show the TL;DR and Tasks overview in chat; the brief reply is the default
called_by: Called by the user and by `crav1-build-task-agent`.
runs by itself: Calls no skill.
you run next: $crav1-fix-build-gaps; $crav1-finalize-commit
first: `$crav1-verify-build-against-spec @docs/specs/<slug>/`
walkthrough: from-verify.md
human: https://github.com/Crav1on/crav1-spec-kit/blob/v1.207.0/docs/reference/skills/crav1-verify-build-against-spec.md
